projecthero.guide.iron_man.controls: Wearing a suit the six ability keys are R / G / X / Z / V / C; every mark has its own kit (see the Mark pages below, or press I for the spec sheet). Double-tap jump in the air to fly (except the Mark 1, which flies only with its Flight Burst). Unarmoured, C puts on any armour you are carrying straight away, and Sneak + C opens the Call Armour picker -- it lists every suit on your Suit Platforms (even ones in unloaded chunks or far away) and in your inventory, shows the hovered suit's stats side by side with your current one, can send a suit home to its platform for repairs, and has a PILOT button for flying a suit remotely. The Mark 5 never answers C: it lives in its suitcase. Iron Man armour makes you immune to fall damage, and flying hard into the ground slams down for 20 damage, knocking everything nearby away.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.auto_feed.bod: Every suit from the Mark 3 up feeds you from your inventory when you are hungry enough not to waste it -- any safe food, modded food included, and bowls and bottles come back. It never touches raw meat or fish, food with side effects (rotten flesh, spider eyes, pufferfish), chorus fruit, suspicious stew or golden apples. The Mark 1 and Mark 2 don't feed you.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.mark_4.body: 3000 energy (+5/s), 1750 integrity (+3/s) soaking half of every hit, immune to arrows and fire, diamond-grade, +7 melee, breathes underwater, auto-feeds, targeting HUD. The full Mark 3 kit with +2 damage on every move and every cooldown 2 s shorter: R Repulsor (17; hold 1 s for 22), Sneak + R Dash (22). G fires the V wheel weapon: Rockets (37), Miniguns (12 per shot) or Micro-Missiles (4 x 27); Sneak + G Sonic Clap (22). X Flares, Sneak + X JARVIS scan. Hold Z Unibeam (22 per hit). Sneak + V Energy Shield.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.mark_v.body: 2500 energy (+5/s), 800 integrity (+2/s) soaking half of every hit, immune to arrows and fire, diamond-grade, +6 melee, breathes underwater, auto-feeds, targeting HUD. The Mark 2 kit with an instant repulsor (no spin-up) and V Gauntlet Blades. C folds it into its suitcase in 4 s -- the case lands in your hand, then your hotbar, then your inventory. Right-click the case to suit up in 6 s: hold it out, it becomes the chestplate, then the arms, legs, helmet and faceplate build on. C and the Call Armour picker never deploy it. Fresh Fabricator pieces: with all four in your inventory, right-click one to pack them into a case.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.combat.body: Any repulsor hit Staggers its target for 3 s (the Mark 1's punch and flamethrower do it too): it slows, crackles with sparks, and your next punch on it deals bonus damage. Punch then repulsor within 1.5 s for extra knockback. As integrity falls the suit shows it: sparks below 60%, scorched cracked plating, smoke and a flickering glow below 35%, and a cracked visor on your HUD.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.jarvis.body: JARVIS talks you through the fight: suit online, low energy, hull damage, first target lock, sealing up underwater, Protocol Phoenix and more. The Mark 1 only has crude SYSTEM readouts. Type /jarvis off (or on) to mute him.
Unsuited, open the Call Armour picker and press PILOT on a charged full suit. It deploys as a drone and your view jumps into it: WASD flies, Jump / Sneak go up and down, Sprint boosts, click or R fires its repulsor. Your real body stays behind and can be hurt. The link ends if you press C, take damage, go past 96 m or run out of energy; the drone then flies back and docks in your inventory.
